/dor ba'i thig gi yas mar rtse// rtsig phyi pha gu'i nang thig reg /de nas 'phred du cha phran gnyis// de nas gyen du mda' yab kyi// phyi thig la reg gru bzhir sbrel// de phyir cha phran gcig dor ba'i// mun 'khor pha gu'i nang thig reg /mun pa'i logs su ka ba dang*// ka rgyan cha phran re re ste// yas mar 'dod bu'i thig la gtugs// rta babs cha bzhir dang po ni// ka rgyan dang mnyam phyi ma gsum// cha phran res thung tshangs rtse yi// gru gsum pad chos gdugs kyi sa// dbus dor mda' gnyis gtab pa la// pad rgya chos 'khor cha gnyis gnyis// de steng gdugs la cha phran gcig /pad+ma'i g.yas g.yon cha phran re// dor ba ri dwags re re bri// glang rgyab snam gnyis phyi thig dang*// tshangs thig 'dzoms steng nas bzung ste// cha gnyis dbus bskor snam dang po'i// phyi thig tshangs 'dzoms g.yas g.yon du// cha phran gnyis brgal cha gcig gis// bskor la g.yas g.yon rwa'i bab tshul// tshangs phyir gsum dang bu phyir gcig /phyin te ka rgyan rtse nas bskor// de nas 'phred gnyis phyi ru gcig /phyin te snga ma'i tshad des bskor// pad chos 'og tu dbus kyi rwa// rtsa rgya cha chen rtse mo phyed// rtsa thig nang du cha chen gcig /dor bar lha snam gru bzhir gdab// de dbus cha chen gsum po yi// dbus dang phyogs bzhir cha chen re'i// zlum por bskor ba lha'i stegs bu// zhes so// de lta bu'i lha gnas kyi dbus su dri'i thig le gru bzhi dang*/ phyogs bzhir zlum po'i steng du me tog gi tshom bu lnga bkod/ de rnams steng du mañji'i khar sa lha'i maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bcas dang*/ gzhan mchod pa dang gtor ma la sogs ras bris kyi skabs bzhin bsham/ nub gsum du byed na 'di yan chad nub dang po sa chog ste spyi rgyud kyi dgongs pa'o// gal te sa chog byas ma thag sta gon byed dgos pa byung na gong ltar bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas gtor ma dang mchod pa byin rlabs bya/

las thig tshar nas lha'i nga rgyal dran tsam byas nas sta gon la 'jug kyang rung*/ nyin gnyis pa sta gon la gzhan thams cad ras bris kyi skabs dang 'dra ba las/ dbang bskur dang 'brel na slob ma sta gon tshar ba'i rjes dang*/ sgrub mchod dkyus ma la gtor ma btang tshar ba'i rjes su/ slob dpon gyi mdun du gzhi gtsang ma'i steng du rdo rje'i rtses dbus su tshon dkar po la ra/ shar du dmar po la aṃ/ lhor ser po la kaṃ/ nub tu ljang gu la wa/ byang du nag po la ha bri/ so so'i kha dog dang mthun pa'i thig skud rnams kyang bzhag mchod pa lnga bsham/ thig tshon bsang sbyangs byas la/ stong pa'i ngang las thig tshon so so la bris pa ltar gyi yig 'bru rnams su gyur/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs te yig 'bru rnams la thim pas/ thig tshon dkar po ra las chos dbyings ye shes dkar po/ dmar po aṃ las rgyal ba thub dka' dmar po/ ser po kaṃ las thub pa gser 'od ser po/ ljang gu wa las thub pa byang chub snying po ljang gu/ nag po ha las phyag na rdo rje nag po rnams ngo bo ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin la rnam pa lha sku snang la rang bzhin med pa phyag rgya sna tshogs kyis bzhugs par bsams te/ tshon la/ 'di ni chos dbyings dag pa ste// sems can khams ni rnam sbyong ba// 'di ni bdag nyid de bzhin gshegs// nyes pa thams cad rnam par spangs// zhes dang*/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ sarba mu khe bh+yaḥ a sa me/ pa ra me/ a tsa le/ ga ga ne/ s+pha ra ṇa/ sarba tra ga te swā hā/ zhes dang*/ oṃ tsi tra sa ma ya mā ti kra ma hūm̐ zhes pas tshon dang*/ las sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pas thig byin gyis brlab/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe sogs nas ni wi d+ya āḥhūm̐/ lha rnams zhu ba las byung ba'i ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin gyi thig dang tshon du gyur par bsams la/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis yi ge rnams bsub/

las sngags brjod cing thig skud rnams sor mo lnga'i steng du re re nas bzhag pa/ dang po so so dang de nas lhan cig bsgril la rdo rje la dkris te dri bzang gi chus gtor/ 'di dag ni rje rdo rje 'chang gi bya rgyud spyi rnam dang*/ 'jam dbyangs dkon lhun gyi bya spyod spyi'i thig tshon byin rlabs nas bshad pa bzhin bris pa yin cing*/ paṇa chen gu ge pa'i 'jam dbyangs dkar po lha lnga'i dkyil chog las/ bsang sbyang*/ sta gon gyi lha'i thugs ka nas ye shes kyi thig dang*/ tshon spyan drangs shing thim pas ye shes kyi rang bzhin gyi thig tshon du gyur par bsams la/ gtso bo'i sngags nyer gcig brjod cing mig gis bltas pas/ mang por sbar bar bsgom mo// zhes gsungs pas de tsam gyis kyang chog par mngon/ gang ltar yang sngar rjes chog ma tshar na skabs 'dir bya'o// de nas slob dpon rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas langs te/ nam mkhar rig gsum gyi dkyil 'khor mngon sum bzhin du bzhugs par bsams la/ oṃ sarba ta tha ga ta tri ku la nā tha maṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ sku gsung thugs 'jam sogs kyis bstod/ rang gtso bo dang*/ slob ma bdud rtsi 'khyil par gyur pa'i mos pas/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi shar nas nub tu phyogs pas/ dzaḥdzaḥdzaḥ brjod cing slob ma nub nas shar du phyogs pa la thig skud gtad/ des kyang dzaḥdzaḥdzaḥbarjod cing blang*/ gnyis kas thig skud lte ba'i thad du bzung ste/ slob dpon gyis/ nam mkha' gang ba'i de bzhin gshegs// 'gro don mdzad dus 'dir lags na// khyed rnams 'dir ni gshegs gsol bar// thig skud sgras ni skul ma 'debs// zhes brjod cing*/ thig skud kyi sgra las kyang de lta bu zhig byung bar bsams la/ oṃ sū traṃ sa ma ya mā ti kra ma hūm̐ zhes brjod cing thog mar steng nas 'og tu bcus te nam mkha' la gyen du gdab/ de nas lus smad de sa gzhi la gdab bo// de nas slob dpon g.yas skor gyis rgyab nas phyin te lhor 'dug

de bzhin du slob ma'ang song nas byang du 'dug pas tshangs thig gnyis pa gdab/ yang slob dpon g.yas skor gyis song nas shar lho dang*/ de bzhin du slob ma byang shar du song la shar gyi logs thig gdab/ yang slob dpon de nyid du gnas pa dang slob ma lho nub tu song la lho'i logs thig gdab/ yang slob dpon g.yas skor gyis nub byang du 'dug slob ma sngar gyi der gnas pas nub kyi logs thig gdab/ slob dpon de nyid du 'dug la slob ma byang shar du song la byang gi logs thig gdab/ slob dpon shar lho dang slob ma nub byang du song la mtshams thig dang po gdab/ slob dpon lho nub dang slob ma byang shar du rgyab 'gros spangs te song la mtshams thig gnyis pa gdab/ de yang*/ shar nub lho byang me dbang ldan// me srin rlung srin rlung dbang ldan// me rlung srin dbang gnyis sdebs kyi// snga ma slob dpon 'dug sa yin// 'gro tshe rgyab nas g.yas skor du// phyin pas thig rjes g.yas skor 'byung*// zhes pa ltar btab pas dkyil 'khor du lam gyis byung bar bsams la/ slob dpon shar dang slob ma nub tu gnas pas thig skud bsdu/ btab zin pa na slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi nub tu song la/ gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya spyi bor bzlog ste/ oṃ badz+ra bi gā kra ma hoḥ zhes pas ye thig nam mkha' la btegs pa'i 'og nas 'dzul bar bsams la/ dkyil 'khor gyi nang du zhugs te/ 'di ni chos dbyings dag pa ste// zhes sogs kyi tshigs bcad dang*/ tsi tra sa ma ya sogs brjod cing*/ g.yon pa'i khu tshur gyis dang por dbang ldan gyi rtsig pa nang nas rim pas bri/ de nas dbus nas ci bde bar bri ste/ tshon tho ba ni/ lha snam dang nang gi lha'i stegs bu shar dkar/ lho sngo/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ dbus ser/ de'i dbus dang phyogs gzhan du zla gdan/ byang du nyi gdan/ de rnams kyi steng du lha so so'i sku mdog dang mthun pa'i tshon spungs sam/

phyag mtshan so so'i mdog can/ glegs bam dngos sam tshon phung ser po re dgod/ rtsig pa nang nas rim bzhin ser/ dkar/ sngo/ 'dod snam dmar/ pha gu ser/ drwa ba'i gzhi sngo/ drwa ba dkar/ mda' yab khra bo/ pu shu dkar/ de'i phyi thig sngo skya/ mun pa dang glang rgyab nag ka ba dang*/ ka rgyan shar dkar/ lho sngo/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ rta babs bzhi dmar/ sngo/ ljang*/ ser/ de steng pad+ma/ chos 'khor/ gdugs sogs ci mdzes/ nyi dkyil ljang*/ pad+ma sna tshogs kyi phyi dmar skya/ rdo rwa'i gzhi nag rdo rje dkar/ me ri sna tshogs so// bris tshar nas rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs ye shes kyi thig phab nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs las thig dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa la bsre/ tshon lhag dang thig la nyer spyod lngas mchod de/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra muḥ zhes pas gshegs su gsol/ dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' mar dri bzang po'i lde gus legs par byug mchod gtor sogs sta gon bzhin bsham/ rgyan dgram/ slob dpon gyis rnam rgyal dang*/ slob mas las bum thogs la so so'i sngags brjod cing rol mo dang bcas pas bskor ba lan gsum byas la/ shar nas lha gsum gyi sngags kyi mthar/ khyed rnams kyis bdag dang rdo rje slob ma rnams la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes sam/ sgrub mchod dkyus ma la/ bdag cag rnams la zhes bsgyur ba brjod cing lha gnas rnams su 'bul tshul byas la de rnams dang*/ 'jug sgo'i bum pa bcas shar du bzhag las bum la a mri ta'i mthar/ bdag dang rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi bar chad thams cad bsrung du gsol/ zhes sam/ bdag cag rnams kyi zhes bsgyur ba brjod cing dbang ldan du bzhag pa ni nub gnyis pa sta gon no// gsum pa dngos gzhi la cho ga thams cad ras bris dang 'dra zhing zhag mang po sbrel te byed na/ nyin snga ma rnams la rjes chog gi rdul tshon gyi lha la brtan bzhugs dang*/ gshegs gsol gyi nyin brtan bzhugs kyi tshab tu khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad ces sogs dang*/

badz+ra muḥzhes pas ye shes pa gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsams la/ gnas gsum bsrungs te/ chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin stong pa nyid du dran pa'i sgo nas/ a kā ro'i sngags brjod cing rdo rje'i rtses dbang ldan gyi rtsig pa nas rim par bsubs la/ rdul tshon mtha' nas dbus su bsdus te za ma tog la sogs par spyan drang*/ dri bzang gi chus thig rjes mi mngon par bya/ ting nge 'dzin gyi phur bu btab pa/ oṃ ru ru s+phu ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sid+dhi lo tsa na sarba ar+tha sā dha na swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags brjod cing bton par bsam/ bkra shis dang rol mo'i sgra sna tshogs bya zhing phyogs kun tu me tog sil mas gtor te dkar gsum gyi dga' ston rgya chen po dang bsngo ba smon lam la sogs pa bya'o// sa chog dang thig tshon gyi bya ba 'di rnams rang rang gi sgos chos phra mo bsgyur ba tsam ma gtogs bya spyod kyi dkyil 'khor gang la'ang sbyar du rung ngo*// de rnams kyis rdul tshon la brten pa'i khyad chos rnams bshad zin to// //de ltar rigs gsum spyi'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga phrin las lhun grub ces bya ba 'di ni/ rje btsun bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' drin gyis 'tsho ba/ dge slong ga ga na shrī bha dras bya spyod kyi srol 'dzin chen po kha che ye shes rdo rje la sogs pa rnams kyi gzhung la gtugs shing*/ bla ma mkhas pa'i phyag len gyis kyang brgyan te/ shing mo lug lo dbyar zla ra ba'i tshes lnga'i nyin dpal e wam̐ chos ldan gyi dben gnas thar pa rtser sbyar ba'o//

zhes thar rtse paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i rigs gsum spyi'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga 'di nyid/ las dang po pa rnams la phan pa'i phyir sogs khongs rnams su dkyus su bcug zhar byung rdul tshon gyi khyad chos sogs gsal byed phran bu'i zhal skong dang bcas mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin las tshul 'di'i bka' drin rol pa'i bya bral chos rje 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po kun dga' bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis dpal sde dge lhun grub steng gi chos grwa chen por bris pa dge legs mchog tu gyur cig sarba dā shre yo bha ba tu// ༈ /rigs gsum spyi'i bsnyen thabs gzhan phan lhun grub ces bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru tri ku la nā thā ya/ rigs gsum spyi'i bsnyen pa bya ba'i tshul la/ bya spyod kyi rgyud sde so so'i rang lugs ltar bsnyen pa sogs bya ba'i tshul ni rgyud sde spyi'i rnam gzhag dang*/ bsnyen yig spyir btang rnams las shes par 'gyur la/ 'dir da ltar gyi phyag gzhes dkyus ma ltar bsnyen pa las rung tsam gtong bar 'dod pas lag tu len pa'i tshul la gsum/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po ni/ 'di nyid kyi dbang bskur ba thob cing*/ dam tshig dang sdom pa rnam par dag pa/ nges 'byung dang byang chub sems kyis rgyud legs par 'byongs shing*/ gzhan don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang myur du 'grub par 'dod pas/ bkra shis shing dben la nyams dga' ba'i gnas su/ rang dbang 'dus nges pa'i bsam gtan gyi khang bur phyag dar bya/ dri bzang po'i chus chag chag gdab cing spos kyis bdug sha chang sgog btsong sogs spangs nas dkar gsum gtso bor gyur pa'i kha zas dang*/ byung na pags pa can dang ma 'brel ba'i gos sogs dang mtshams g.yog rnams lhus thing bar byas/ gza' skar sbyor byed bzang po 'dzom pa'i tshe mtshams kyi bcad rgya bya/

'byor na rigs gsum spyi'i sku bris 'bur dang dkon mchog gi rten ci 'byor bshams pa'i mdun du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i mchod pa dang*/ gtor ma dkar po zlum po bzhi bshams pa'i dang po gzungs gtor te yi dam gyi lha la 'bul rgyu yin/ gnyis pa chos skyong nag po chen po 'khor bcas la/ gsum pa dang*/ bzhi pa phyogs skyong dang 'byung po/ bgegs gtor nyin re bzhin 'dor rgyu byed/ sgrub pa po rang nyid stan nang tshangs can/ byung na 'og tu shing khri dang bcas pa/ shing khri yod na 'og tu rdul tshon gyis rdo rje rgya gram bri/ med na g.yam pa sogs la rdo rje rgya gram bris pa gdan gyi 'og tu bzhag kha blta phyogs byung na shar du bya/ ye ma byung na khyim gyi mdo phug dang bstun/ thog ma nyid du rtsa ba'i bla ma sogs rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma la gsol ba drag tu btab/ cha gsum yid ches ngo shes pa yan gsum la sogs pa btang*/ sgrub pa la bar chad mi 'byung ba'i phrin las bcol la mtshams dam du bcad/ grub na theg pa chen po'i gso sbyong spyi ltar blang ngo*// gnyis pa ni/ bde ba'i stan la bsam gtan gyi spyod lam dang ldan pas 'khod de/ sa phyogs dang gnas khang thams cad dag pa'i zhing gi bkod pa tshad med par gsal ba'i mdun gyi nam mkhar skyabs yul rnams mngon sum bzhin du bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar bdag gzhan sems can thams cad sgo gsum 'jug pa gcig pas skyabs su 'gro bar mos la/ bdag dang 'gro ba zhes sogs skyabs 'gro nas bzung bzlas pa'i bar gyi ngag 'don rnams thar rtse paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i dkyil chog gi dbu nas 'byung ba ltar bya/ bzlas pa thog mar 'jam dbyangs kyi sngags gtso bor bzla/ thun mjug rnams su 'khor gnyis kyi sngags kyang cung zad re bzlas rjes/ mdun bskyed kyi lha la mchod bstod nas bzung*/ rang dam tshig pa'i nga rgyal gyis 'khod par gyur/

ces brjod cing bsam pa'i bar sgrub thabs kyi dkyus ltar la/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rigs gsum mgon po 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog /ces dang*/ brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs dang lam rim gyi smon lam 'brel mtshungs su bya bar spro na'ang 'dir bya ba phyag len du 'byung bas/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang dang gsang ba'i bdag /in+d+ra bhū ti grub brnyes 'chi med zhabs// 'phags pa klu sgrub klu yi byang chub dang*// ye shes rdo rje rnams la gsol ba 'debs// grags 'byor shes rab bla chen sa skya pa// rje btsun grags pa sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta// shākya grags dang de dpon kun dga' dpal// dar ma ye shes rnams la= /bag ston che dang tshul khrims rgyal mtshan zhabs// ngag gi dbang po byang chub seng ge dang*// gzhon nu blo gros ngor chen rdo rje 'chang*// kun dga' dbang phyug= /rat+na war+dha lha mchog seng ge dang*// sangs rgyas seng ge paṇa chen brang ti pa// sgrub khang pa dang shes rab 'byung gnas zhabs// lhun grub dpal ldan= /sangs rgyas phun tshogs bstan 'dzin lhun grub dang*// nam mkha' bsam 'grub kun dga' blo gros zhabs// nam mkha' 'chi med kun dga' bstan 'dzin dpal// rtsa ba'i bla ma= /sngon 'gro rim pas rang rgyud legs sbyangs nas// bdag mdun grogs po lta bu'i rnal 'byor dang*// skyon brgyad spangs pa'i bzlas brjod la 'bad pas// grub gnyis kun dga' gsar pa myong bar shog /bsnyen sogs rnam par dag byas 'gro kun la// dmigs med snying rjes kun bslangs dkyil 'khor cher// 'jug cing skal ba dang mtshams chos bstan pas// 'brel tshad don ldan 'jam dbyangs rjes 'gror shog /'khor 'das shes bya rtogs pa'i blo gros dang*// lus can srid las gdon pa'i snying stobs dang*// tshar bcad rjes su 'dzin pa'i mthu stobs sogs// rigs gsum yon tan rgya mtsho thob par shog

/ces dang*/ gzhan yang bsngo smon gang shes byas nas thun mtshams kyi bya ba la 'jug thun bzhi'am gsum gang mos bya/ thun gyi bsgang la ngag bcad dang*/ ja lta bu ma gtogs kha zas rags pa mi za/ chab len sogs gtsang sbra dang*/ bdag mdun gyi lha sku'i gsal snang la sems rtse gcig tu 'dzin/ 'od zer spro bsdu sogs dmigs pa go ma 'gags pa la bslab pas mtshon sems gzhan du ma yengs pa dang*/ gnyid rmug sogs kyi dbang du mi btang bar bzlas brjod kyi skyon rnams spangs la bzla/ dge sbyor chag med gzhan gang dgos rnams thun mtshams rnams su bya/ snga thun gyi mjug tu gtor ma 'bul ba phyag len du mdzad pas/ thun mgor mchod pa dang gtor ma zhal gsos la chab kyis bran/ mchod pa rnams a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā bas sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las sogs nas/ dharmā ra ṇi ta lan gsum rol mo dang bcas pas byin dbab pa'i bar dkyil chog gi dbu nas 'byung ba ltar bya/ skyabs 'gro nas bzung*/ rang dam tshig pa'i nga rgyal gyis 'khod par gyur ces pa'i bar dkyus ltar la/ gtor ma chu gtsang gis bran/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā bas sbyang*/ a kā ro phyag rgya bcas pas brlab/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas bcom ldan 'das rigs gsum gyi dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dza/ zhes pas gtor mgron spyan drang*/ de rnams kyi zhal las 'od kyi sbu gu byung nas gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ a ra pa tsa na dhīḥsogs sngags gsum sbrel ba'i mthar/ oṃ a kā ro sogs btags pa lan gsum gyis phul/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tri ku la nā tha sa pa ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ sku gsung thugs 'jam sogs kyis bstod/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sogs kyis 'dod don gsol/ gtor ma gnyis pa sgos kyi chos skyong dang*/ lhag ma rnams cha gsum gyi cho gas btang ba'i tshul dkyil 'khor ltar bya/

bgegs gtor phyir dor tshar nas/ mdun gyi gtor mgron yi dam dang chos skyong la dmigs te/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bshags/ rten yod na/ 'dir ni gzugs dang lhan cig tu// 'gro ba'i don du bzhugs nas kyang*// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// mchog rnams legs par stsal du gsol// oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ya swā hā/ zhes brjod cing me tog 'thor ba dang bcas brtan bzhugs bya/ med na/ oṃ/ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ badz+ra muḥzhes dang*/ mtheb srin gyis se gol gtog pa dang bcas gtor mgron rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par bsam/ dge ba 'di yis sogs bsngo smon brgyud 'debs gong ltar bya'o// gsum pa ni/ de lta bu'i rim pas grangs bsnyen gtso bo la 'bru 'bum ste 'bum phrag bdun kha skong dang bcas pa dang*/ 'khor gnyis la de'i bcu cha ste khri phrag bdun kha skong dang bcas pa legs par grub nas/ sngags kyi lhag chad kha skong ba dang*/ nus pa dbyung ba'i phyir zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya spyod spyi'i lugs kyi cho gas khog phubs te khyad chos rnams ma 'khrul par sbyar bas sngags kyi bcu cha 'bul/ de nas mtshams khad kyis grol ba dang*/ rgyun du'ang sgom bzlas ma chag par brtson pa sogs kyis mtshon mtshams kyi spang blang thams cad bsnyen yig spyi 'gro ltar shes par bya'o// de ltar bgyis pa'i phan yon kyang*/ spyir bya spyod kyi rgyud las sngags kyi dngos grub rab rig pa 'dzin pa'i go 'phang la brten nas byang chub chen po 'grub pa dang*/ 'bring grub pa chen po/ tha ma zhi sogs dman pa'i las rab 'byams ji snyed cig gsungs pa de thams cad kyang bzlas brjod dang*/ sbyin sreg kho nas grub pa'i tshul legs par grub pa'i rgyud las/ rab 'bring tha ma re re la'ang*// dngos grub rnam pa gsum dbye ba// gsang sngags rnams kyi mthur shes nas// dngos grub phyir ni bsnyen pa brtsam// zhes dang*/

cho ga 'di dag byas pa yis// lha rnams yongs su dgyes par 'gyur// dgyes par gyur nas dngos grub ni// chen po myur du stsol bar mdzad// ces dang*/ gzhan yang bzlas brjod kyis sdig sgrib thams cad zad nas sems dwang ba'i ting nge 'dzin khyad par can thob cing*/ de las 'jig rten dang 'jig rten 'das pa'i dngos grub thams cad 'thob par 'gyur ba yin te/ dpung bzang gis zhus pa las/ tshe rabs gzhan du gang dang gang byas pa'i// sdig pa ma lus bzlas brjod byas pas 'byung*// bzlas pas sdig pa ma lus byang byas nas// dwang ba'i yid kyis dngos grub thob par 'gyur// zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs shing*/ bye brag tu bcom ldan 'das rigs gsum mgon po ni rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i mkhyen brtse nus gsum gcig tu bsdus pa'i rang gzugs su grub pas gang gis bsnyen pa rnams la thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam gyi snying po stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab/ dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje/ bdud dang bdud kyi ris kyis mi brdzi ba'i mthu chen po thob pas mthar thug byang chub mchog gi go 'phang la myur du reg pa dang*/ bya ba'i rgyud sogs las lhag pa'i lha'i rigs ji snyed cig gsungs pa thams cad kyang de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ pad+ma dang*/ rdo rje'i rigs gsum du 'du zhing*/ de rnams kyi rigs kyi bdag po'ang 'jam dpal/ spyan ras gzigs/ phyag na rdo rje gsum du nges pas/ 'di'i bsnyen pa rdzogs pas rigs thams cad kyi bsnyen pa las su rung zhing dngos grub bsgrub pa la dbang bas mtshon dgos pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ bye brag 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rgyud dang*/ spyan ras gzigs yi ge drug pa'i gzungs/ phyag rdor dbang bskur gyi rgyud sogs sngags rgyud rab 'byams dang*/ mdo sde rin po che rnams nas 'phags pa 'di rnams kyi mtshan gzung ba dang*/ dran pa tsam la'ang phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab par bsngags pa'i phyir/
